name: Harmony 350, the test setup built from nothing
description: The remote holds lab work/setups/h350-test/from-nothing-5.1.6.bin: the whole test setup built with no Logitech file as input, every device on its key's short or long press, Watch TV with the LG TV's and the Denon's inputs and its flag, and the five favourite channels 1, 2, 3, 666 and 07 on the KPN, all composed by ours onto the empty configuration of 5.1.5. Unlike 4.5, nothing on the remote is Logitech's, so every device key is pressed short and long and Watch TV is pressed. packages/codec/test/families/harmony-300-350/noscreenfromnothing.test.ts holds the file equal to Logitech's second compile of the test setup by content but for the KPN's map, which binds the family's 43 keys where Logitech's binds 12, and two LG TV codes nothing sends. packages/bench/test/harmony-300-350/fromnothing350.test.ts derives every expectation below from the file and checks that every step but step 14 sends the same codes, by their bytes, as Logitech's compile, which the 3.3 run heard; so steps 1 to 13 and 15 are predicted to pass. The monitor names the codes through Logitech's compile, whose frames they are byte for byte, and step 14's through this file. Predicted per step: 1 the LG TV's own VolumeUp and Info, a television keeping its volume; 2 the Knoll chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp, which Logitech routes to the receiver and the composer copies, and the Knoll's Timer on Up; 3 the Plasma's own VolumeUp and Menu; 4 Kodi chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and Kodi's Enter; 5 the Denon's VolumeUp and Info; 6 the Switch chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and the Switch's Input1 on 1; 7 the KPN chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and the KPN's ChannelPrev; 8 the Sony HT chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and its Stop; 9 the Plasma's PowerOn and then its PowerOff, its power variable starting at off when the remote seeds it from the file, so if the two come the other way round the remote kept another state; the PowerOff waits out the Plasma's 5 s power on delay; 10 Watch TV from everything off: the LG TV's PowerOn, the Denon's power on (code 6, which the catalogue does not name), the KPN's PowerToggle, and then the Denon's CBL/SAT input, held back by the Denon's 2 s power on delay; the LG TV's HDMI 1 sends nothing; any code may come late behind a delay, so wait about fifteen seconds before the next step; if power offs come instead, the remote did not seed the power states from the file; Watch TV leaves the remote in the KPN's mode; 11 channels 1, 2 and 3, one KPN digit each; 12 channel 666, the KPN's 6 three times about a third of a second apart, which the monitor may show as one press with repeats; 13 channel 07, the KPN's 0 and then its 7, nothing after them; 14 the KPN's ChannelUp and then its 1, expected by their numbers in this file: Logitech's compile binds neither in the KPN's mode and the 3.3 run heard nothing there, so this is the one step where our file is predicted to differ audibly from Logitech's; 15 Watch TV again: the LG TV's PowerOff, the Denon's power off (code 12) and the KPN's PowerToggle, and no input. A long press is held until the device key flashes; let go earlier it counts as a short press. The favourite keys are the five numbered 1 to 5 around Input: 1 and 5 beside it, 2, 3 and 4 below it.

steps.instruction: Long press TV/Media → Volume Up → Up
Long press Cable/PC → Volume Up → Enter
Long press DVD/Music → Volume Up → Stop
